Explicit staff/superuser flags or reviewed alternative, restricted AdminSite/backend/manager and recovery; no custom bypass. Any schema changes separate.
Resolve finance/signature/rating/message/report/audience/privacy rules and settings deployment; readiness and service activation remain separate from catalogue approval.
